description:
Activate Gyre Engineer by tapping it, adding {G}{U}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Gyre Engineer.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Gyre Engineer.
Repeat.
